author: reek
body: Smoke test for RP2040 (Raspberry Pi Pico) board drivers. MMIO stubs return 0 on the hosted VM, so this exercises the driver logic and bit manipulation without real hardware. Fuel-bounded waits terminate immediately since status registers read as 0.

author: reek
body: The discriminating cases are the pure ones: the WS2812 colour packer, the PIO instruction list, and the USB descriptor builders reach no register, so they stay bound with plain lets. If someone gives one of them a register access later, these lines stop compiling.

author: reek
body: The colour packing is pure, so red, green, and blue are plain lets and the three checks on them are computed before the act block ever runs. Only the PIO traffic -- init, put-pixel, send-strip -- is act-bound.
